note: Read 2026-11-03. Majority: the Minors Act (Chapter 6), s. 2: full age at eighteen instead of twenty-one, from 29 December 1976; held, in place of the person research's reading of eighteen from the Child Protection Act (research/sources/person/ages/BS.json), which hadn't reached an Act on full age. Work: null here; the person research's working age (sixteen, the Child Protection Act 2007, s. 7) and its reading that no law sanctions performing below it are read from that file (tools/papers/ages/person.ts). The Employment Act's First Schedule, read the same day, let a child under fourteen work in listed undertakings, among them 'any film as may be approved by the Minister' (S.I. 96/2003), 'For a period of five years from the coming into operation of this Act' (2001); that window had closed before the Child Protection Act came into force (2009), so the film exception isn't held. Service: not read (the game doesn't read service).

sources.title: Minors Act, Chapter 6, s. 2 (Statute Law of The Bahamas, Office of the Attorney General)
sources.said: As from the date of the commencement of this Act a person shall attain full age on attaining the age of eighteen instead of on attaining the age of twenty-one
